title: Google Workspace Posture
description: Google Workspace identity and security posture artifact.

schema_version.x-epack-summary: Version of the artifact format. Always 1.0.0 for this collector.

collected_at.x-epack-summary: UTC timestamp of when the collector ran.

collected_at_level.description: Collection level the artifact was produced at. Audit and internal additions are strictly additive; the schema version stays 1.0.0 (the collector binary version carries the level-aware signal).

usage_report_date.description: Date of the Google Workspace usage report snapshot (typically yesterday). Null when no usage report could be read.
usage_report_date.x-epack-summary: Date of the usage report the report-based values come from. It is usually a few days before the run.

org_domain.description: Primary domain of the Google Workspace tenant. Null when the tenant record could not be read; only a Super Admin can read it.
org_domain.x-epack-summary: Primary domain of the Google Workspace tenant.

customer_id.description: Google Workspace customer ID (audit and above). Null when the tenant record could not be read; only a Super Admin can read it.

total.description: Total user accounts, from the usage report.
total.x-epack-summary: User accounts in the tenant in every state, from the usage report. The usage report percentages are taken over this count.
total.x-epack-method: Reads accounts:num_users from the customer usage report for the newest day Google has published, up to 10 days back.

suspended.description: Suspended user accounts, from the usage report.
suspended.x-epack-summary: Suspended accounts, from the usage report. A suspended user cannot sign in, and their data is kept.
suspended.x-epack-method: Reads accounts:num_suspended_users from the customer usage report.

archived.description: Archived user accounts, from the usage report.
archived.x-epack-summary: Archived accounts, from the usage report. An archived user cannot sign in, and their data is kept for retention.
archived.x-epack-method: Reads accounts:num_archived_users from the customer usage report.

active.description: Active (not suspended or archived) users in the live Directory scan. The live percentages are calculated against it.
active.x-epack-summary: Users who are not suspended or archived, from the live Directory scan. The live percentages are taken over this count.
active.x-epack-method: Counts the Directory users that are neither suspended nor archived.

locked_pct.description: Percentage of users currently locked out.
locked_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of total users who are locked out, from the usage report.
locked_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the usage report's accounts:num_locked_users by its accounts:num_users.

inactive_pct.description: Percentage of active users inactive for 90+ days (from Directory API lastLoginTime).
inactive_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of active users with no sign-in in the last 90 days, from the live Directory scan. A user who has never signed in counts as inactive.
inactive_pct.x-epack-method: Counts the active users whose Directory lastLoginTime is more than 90 days before the run, or who never signed in, out of all active users.

inactive_days.x-epack-summary: Days without a sign-in after which a user counts as inactive. It is 90.
inactive_days.x-epack-method: Writes the fixed 90-day threshold of the inactivity count.

inventory.description: Per-user inventory (audit and above). Each row carries primary_email, status, org_unit_path, 2sv flags, and activity flags; internal adds last_login_at. Per-user passkey / password strength are not available per user.
inventory.x-epack-summary: Per-user rows with status, org unit, 2-step verification, and recent activity. The Directory API has no per-user passkey or password strength.

primary_email.x-epack-summary: Primary email address of the user.

archived.x-epack-summary: Whether the account is archived. An archived user cannot sign in.

org_unit_path.description: Path of the org unit the user belongs to.
org_unit_path.x-epack-summary: Path of the org unit the user belongs to. Policies such as 2-step verification enforcement apply by org unit.

agreed_to_terms.description: Whether the user has accepted the Google Workspace terms of service.
agreed_to_terms.x-epack-summary: Whether the user has accepted the Google Workspace terms of service. A user accepts them at the first sign-in.

ip_allowlisted.description: Whether the user's IP address is subject to Google's deprecated IP allowlist setting.
ip_allowlisted.x-epack-summary: Whether the user's IP address is subject to Google's deprecated IP allowlist setting.

2sv_enrolled.description: Whether the user is enrolled in 2-step verification.
2sv_enrolled.x-epack-summary: Whether the user has set up 2-step verification.

2sv_enforced.description: Whether a policy requires 2-step verification for the user.
2sv_enforced.x-epack-summary: Whether a policy requires 2-step verification for the user.

active_7d.description: Whether the user last signed in within the 7 days before the run.
active_7d.x-epack-summary: Whether the user signed in within the 7 days before the run.

active_30d.description: Whether the user last signed in within the 30 days before the run.
active_30d.x-epack-summary: Whether the user signed in within the 30 days before the run.

last_login_at.description: When the user last signed in. Absent when the user has never signed in.
last_login_at.x-epack-summary: When the user last signed in.

change_password_at_next_login.description: Whether the user must change their password at the next sign-in.
change_password_at_next_login.x-epack-summary: Whether the user must change their password at the next sign-in. An admin often sets this after a password reset.

truncated_inventory.description: True when the per-user inventory was capped (50,000 rows, ACTIVE-first then email ascending). Omitted when within the cap.
truncated_inventory.x-epack-summary: Whether the user list was capped at 50,000 rows. Active users are kept first.

truncated_inventory_dropped.description: Number of user inventory rows dropped by the cap. Omitted when within the cap.
truncated_inventory_dropped.x-epack-summary: Users left out of the list by the cap.

active_7d_pct.description: Percentage of active users who logged in within the last 7 days, from the live Directory scan.
active_7d_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of active users who signed in within the last 7 days, from the live Directory scan.

active_30d_pct.description: Percentage of active users who logged in within the last 30 days, from the live Directory scan.
active_30d_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of active users who signed in within the last 30 days, from the live Directory scan.

activity.x-epack-summary: Shares of active users who signed in recently, from the live Directory scan.

2sv_enrolled_pct.description: Percentage of active users enrolled in 2-step verification, from the live Directory scan.
2sv_enrolled_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of active users who have set up 2-step verification, from the live Directory scan. It counts users whether or not a policy requires it.
2sv_enrolled_pct.x-epack-method: Counts the active Directory users with isEnrolledIn2Sv set, out of all active users.

2sv_enforced_pct.description: Percentage of active users with 2-step verification enforced by policy, from the live Directory scan.
2sv_enforced_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of active users whom a policy requires to use 2-step verification, from the live Directory scan.
2sv_enforced_pct.x-epack-method: Counts the active Directory users with isEnforcedIn2Sv set, out of all active users.

2sv_protected_pct.description: Percentage of users actually protected by 2-step verification.
2sv_protected_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of total users protected by 2-step verification, from the usage report.
2sv_protected_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the usage report's accounts:num_users_2sv_protected by its accounts:num_users.

passkey_users_pct.description: Percentage of users with passkeys enrolled.
passkey_users_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of total users with a passkey, from the usage report. Passkeys resist phishing.
passkey_users_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the usage report's accounts:num_users_with_passkeys_enrolled by its accounts:num_users.

security_keys_total.description: Total number of registered security keys across the tenant.
security_keys_total.x-epack-summary: Hardware security keys registered across the tenant, from the usage report. One user can register several.
security_keys_total.x-epack-method: Reads accounts:num_security_keys from the customer usage report.

authentication.x-epack-summary: Adoption and enforcement of 2-step verification and passkeys. The enrolled and required shares are over active users, and the protected and passkey shares over total users.

privileged_users_count.description: Number of unique active privileged users across super admin and delegated admin roles.
privileged_users_count.x-epack-summary: Active users with a super admin or delegated admin role. Each user counts once.
privileged_users_count.x-epack-method: Counts the active Directory users with isAdmin or isDelegatedAdmin set.

super_admin_count.x-epack-summary: Active super admins. A super admin has full control of the tenant.
super_admin_count.x-epack-method: Counts the active Directory users with isAdmin set.

delegated_admin_count.x-epack-summary: Active users with a delegated admin role. A delegated role grants a limited set of admin privileges.
delegated_admin_count.x-epack-method: Counts the active Directory users with isDelegatedAdmin set.

privileged_users_2sv_enrolled_pct.description: Percentage of active privileged users enrolled in 2-step verification.
privileged_users_2sv_enrolled_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of active privileged users who have set up 2-step verification.
privileged_users_2sv_enrolled_pct.x-epack-method: Counts the active privileged users with isEnrolledIn2Sv set, out of all active privileged users.

privileged_users_2sv_enforced_pct.description: Percentage of active privileged users with 2-step verification enforced.
privileged_users_2sv_enforced_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of active privileged users whom a policy requires to use 2-step verification. An admin who is enrolled but not required can turn 2-step verification off.
privileged_users_2sv_enforced_pct.x-epack-method: Counts the active privileged users with isEnforcedIn2Sv set, out of all active privileged users.

inventory.description: Per-privileged-user inventory (audit and above): primary_email, super/delegated flags, 2sv flags, role names; internal adds the org_unit_scoped flag.
inventory.x-epack-summary: Per-privileged-user rows with role type, 2-step verification flags, role names, and whether any grant is limited to an org unit.

primary_email.x-epack-summary: Primary email address of the privileged user.

super_admin.description: Whether the user is a super administrator.
super_admin.x-epack-summary: Whether the user is a super admin.

delegated_admin.description: Whether the user holds a delegated admin role.
delegated_admin.x-epack-summary: Whether the user holds a delegated admin role.

2sv_enrolled.description: Whether the admin is enrolled in 2-step verification.
2sv_enrolled.x-epack-summary: Whether the admin has set up 2-step verification.

2sv_enforced.description: Whether a policy requires 2-step verification for the admin.
2sv_enforced.x-epack-summary: Whether a policy requires 2-step verification for the admin.

roles.description: Names of the admin roles assigned to the user, and for a delegated admin those assigned to a group the user is in. Absent when the role assignments could not be read.
roles.x-epack-summary: Admin roles granted to the user, such as User Management Admin.

org_unit_scoped.description: Whether any of the admin role grants is limited to an org unit.
org_unit_scoped.x-epack-summary: Whether any of the admin's role grants is limited to an org unit.

custom_roles.description: Admin-defined (non-system) custom roles (audit and above): name, description, privilege_count.
custom_roles.x-epack-summary: Admin roles defined in the tenant, beyond Google's system roles.

name.x-epack-summary: Name of the custom admin role.

privilege_count.description: Number of privileges the role grants.

admins.x-epack-summary: Privileged account counts and their 2-step verification coverage.

weak_password_pct.description: Percentage of users with weak passwords.
weak_password_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of total users with a password rated weak, from the usage report.
weak_password_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the usage report's accounts:num_users_password_strength_weak by its accounts:num_users.

password_length_non_compliant_pct.description: Percentage of users with passwords that do not meet length requirements.
password_length_non_compliant_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of total users whose password is shorter than the length policy requires, from the usage report.
password_length_non_compliant_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the usage report's accounts:num_users_password_length_non_compliant by its accounts:num_users.

policy.description: Configured password policy, reduced to the weakest value in force anywhere in the tenant. Absent when the Policy API could not be read; absence never means permissive.
policy.x-epack-summary: The password rules the tenant requires. Where org units or groups set different rules, these values describe the weakest of them.

minimum_length.description: Smallest minimum password length across every policy in force.
minimum_length.x-epack-summary: Shortest password any policy in force accepts.
minimum_length.x-epack-method: Takes the smallest minimumLength of the security.password policies from the Policy API.

maximum_length.description: Largest maximum password length across every policy in force.
maximum_length.x-epack-summary: Longest password any policy in force accepts.
maximum_length.x-epack-method: Takes the largest maximumLength of the security.password policies from the Policy API.

allowed_strength.description: strong only when every policy in force requires strong passwords. weak when any policy permits weak ones.
allowed_strength.x-epack-summary: Whether every policy in force requires a strong password. Google Workspace has no setting for character classes.

enforce_requirements_at_login.description: True only when every policy in force binds users who already have a password. False means a non-compliant password survives until its owner changes it.
enforce_requirements_at_login.x-epack-summary: Whether every policy in force applies to users who already have a password. When false, an old password that breaks the rules stays valid until its owner changes it.
enforce_requirements_at_login.x-epack-method: Checks that every security.password policy from the Policy API sets enforceRequirementsAtLogin.

allow_reuse.description: True when any policy in force permits reusing a previous password.
allow_reuse.x-epack-summary: Whether any policy in force lets a user set a previous password again.
allow_reuse.x-epack-method: Checks whether any security.password policy from the Policy API sets allowReuse.

expiration_days.description: Longest password expiration across every policy in force. 0 means passwords never expire, which is the weakest setting.
expiration_days.x-epack-summary: Longest time in days a password can be used before it must change, across the policies in force. 0 means passwords never expire.
expiration_days.x-epack-method: Takes the longest expirationDuration of the security.password policies in whole days, and writes 0 when any policy has none.

distinct_policies.description: Number of distinct password policies found. Greater than 1 means the tenant is not uniform and the values in this object describe the floor.
distinct_policies.x-epack-summary: Distinct password policies the tenant defines. Org units and groups with the same rules count once. When there are several, the password policy values describe the weakest of them.
distinct_policies.x-epack-method: Counts the security.password policies from the Policy API, with policies that set the same rules counted once.

passwords.x-epack-summary: Password strength and length across total users, from the usage report, and the password policy.

sign_in.description: Sign-in settings from the Policy API, each the weakest value in force anywhere in the tenant. A value is absent, with a gap, when its policies could not be read.

web_session_duration_max_minutes.description: Longest web session duration any session controls policy sets, in minutes.
web_session_duration_max_minutes.x-epack-summary: Longest time in minutes anyone can stay signed in on the web before signing in again, across the org units and groups that set one.
web_session_duration_max_minutes.x-epack-method: Takes the longest webSessionDuration of the security.session_controls policies from the Policy API, in minutes, rounded up.

less_secure_apps_allowed.description: True when any less secure apps policy still sets allowLessSecureApps. Google stopped supporting less secure apps on May 1, 2025.
less_secure_apps_allowed.x-epack-summary: Whether any org unit or group still has the retired less secure apps setting turned on. Since May 1, 2025, people can't use less secure apps to sign in with only a username and password.
less_secure_apps_allowed.x-epack-method: Checks whether any security.less_secure_apps policy from the Policy API sets allowLessSecureApps.

sign_in.x-epack-summary: How long a web session lasts and whether apps with legacy sign-in are allowed, from the Policy API.

authorized_apps_count.description: Number of third-party apps authorized in the tenant.
authorized_apps_count.x-epack-summary: Third-party apps authorized to access tenant data, from the usage report.

lookback_days.description: Number of days of Context-Aware Access audit history searched for device-state deny events.
lookback_days.x-epack-summary: Days of Context-Aware Access audit history searched for deny events. It is 90.
lookback_days.x-epack-method: Writes the fixed 90-day window of the deny event search.

context_aware_access_denied_events.description: Total Context-Aware Access deny events observed in the lookback window.
context_aware_access_denied_events.x-epack-summary: Context-Aware Access deny events in the lookback window. Access levels in monitor mode log deny events too.
context_aware_access_denied_events.x-epack-method: Counts the ACCESS_DENY_EVENT entries in the Reports API's context_aware_access log for the 90 days before the run.

device_state_denied_events.description: Count of deny events that included a device-state parameter, which is positive evidence that a device-state access level fired.
device_state_denied_events.x-epack-summary: Deny events in the lookback window that cite the device's state. They show that an access level checked a device condition.
device_state_denied_events.x-epack-method: Counts the ACCESS_DENY_EVENT entries in the window that set CAA_DEVICE_STATE.

managed_device_requirement_evidenced.description: Whether Context-Aware Access audit logs show device-state-based access denials. This is deny-event evidence, not proof of complete policy coverage.
managed_device_requirement_evidenced.x-epack-summary: Whether any deny event in the lookback window cites the device's state. When false, the tenant may still require managed devices, since the audit log records only denials.
managed_device_requirement_evidenced.x-epack-method: Checks whether any ACCESS_DENY_EVENT entry in the window sets CAA_DEVICE_STATE.

access_policy_name.description: Access Context Manager policy resource used for config enrichment (audit and above).
access_policy_name.x-epack-summary: Resource name of the Access Context Manager policy.

access_policy_parent.description: Parent organization resource for the access policy (audit and above).
access_policy_parent.x-epack-summary: Organization resource the access policy belongs to.

basic_access_levels_count.description: Number of basic Access Context Manager access levels in the resolved policy.
basic_access_levels_count.x-epack-summary: Basic access levels in the access policy.
basic_access_levels_count.x-epack-method: Counts the access levels in the access policy that have no custom CEL expression.

custom_access_levels_count.description: Number of custom CEL-based access levels in the resolved policy. These are not deeply analyzed by the collector.
custom_access_levels_count.x-epack-summary: Custom CEL access levels in the access policy. The device policy counts leave these out.
custom_access_levels_count.x-epack-method: Counts the access levels in the access policy that have a custom CEL expression.

basic_device_policy_access_levels_count.description: Number of basic access levels that include a devicePolicy condition.
basic_device_policy_access_levels_count.x-epack-summary: Basic access levels with a device policy condition.
basic_device_policy_access_levels_count.x-epack-method: Counts the basic access levels with a devicePolicy in any condition.

basic_managed_device_access_levels_count.description: Number of basic access levels whose required device policies restrict allowed device management levels to managed devices.
basic_managed_device_access_levels_count.x-epack-summary: Basic access levels that require a managed device on every request.
basic_managed_device_access_levels_count.x-epack-method: Counts the basic access levels whose required device policies set allowedDeviceManagementLevels and leave out NONE and MANAGEMENT_UNSPECIFIED. A device policy is required when its condition is not negated and the level joins its conditions with AND or has only one condition.

basic_device_policy_access_level_titles.description: Titles of basic access levels that include a devicePolicy condition.
basic_device_policy_access_level_titles.x-epack-summary: Titles of the basic access levels that carry a device-policy condition.

levels.description: Per-access-level rows (audit and above): title, custom flag, device-policy summary. Internal adds rule details (IP subnetworks, regions, required access levels, allowed device-management and encryption statuses). The device-policy fields other than has_device_policy come from required device policies only. A device policy is required when its condition is not negated and the level joins its conditions with AND or has only one condition.
levels.x-epack-summary: Per-access-level rows with the device policy each level requires.

title.description: The access level's title, or its resource name when it has no title.
title.x-epack-summary: Display title of the access level.

custom.description: Whether the access level is a custom CEL level.
custom.x-epack-summary: Whether the access level is a custom CEL level.

has_device_policy.description: Whether the access level has a devicePolicy condition.
has_device_policy.x-epack-summary: Whether the access level has a device policy condition.

requires_screenlock.description: Whether a required device policy asks for a screen lock.
requires_screenlock.x-epack-summary: Whether every request that meets the access level needs a device with a screen lock.

requires_admin_approval.description: Whether a required device policy asks for a device an admin has approved.
requires_admin_approval.x-epack-summary: Whether every request that meets the access level needs a device an admin has approved.

requires_corp_owned.description: Whether a required device policy asks for a company-owned device.
requires_corp_owned.x-epack-summary: Whether every request that meets the access level needs a company-owned device.

os_constraint_count.description: Number of operating system constraints in the required device policies.
os_constraint_count.x-epack-summary: Operating system constraints, such as a minimum version, in the device policies every request must meet.

allowed_device_management_levels.description: Device management levels the required device policies allow.
allowed_device_management_levels.x-epack-summary: Device-management levels the access level accepts on every request, for example BASIC or COMPLETE.

allowed_encryption_statuses.description: Encryption statuses the required device policies allow.
allowed_encryption_statuses.x-epack-summary: Encryption statuses the access level accepts on every request, for example ENCRYPTED.

ip_subnetworks.description: IP ranges the access level allows.
ip_subnetworks.x-epack-summary: IP ranges the access level allows.

required_access_levels.description: Other access levels this level requires.
required_access_levels.x-epack-summary: Other access levels a request must also meet.

access_context_manager.x-epack-summary: Access levels in the Access Context Manager policy. Present when organization_id or access_policy is configured and the policy can be read.

device_access.x-epack-summary: Context-Aware Access deny events and Access Context Manager settings.

groups.description: Groups surface (audit and above; omitted at trust). Audit: total / admin_created / user_created counts, external_members_allowed count, plus the per-group inventory (email, name, member_count, settings); truncated_inventory / truncated_inventory_dropped report the 10,000-group cap. Internal: per-group member lists (bounded by a 200k total-row cap; truncated_group_memberships flags that cap).

external_members_allowed.description: Groups whose settings allow external members. Null when the settings of some groups could not be read.
external_members_allowed.x-epack-summary: Groups whose settings allow members from outside the tenant.

admin_created.description: Whether an admin created the group.
admin_created.x-epack-summary: Whether an admin created the group.

allow_external_members.description: Whether the group settings allow members from outside the tenant. Null when the settings could not be read.
allow_external_members.x-epack-summary: Whether the group's settings allow members from outside the tenant.

who_can_join.x-epack-summary: Join setting, such as ALL_IN_DOMAIN_CAN_JOIN or INVITED_CAN_JOIN.

who_can_post_message.description: Who can post to the group.

role.description: Role in the group, such as OWNER, MANAGER, or MEMBER.
role.x-epack-summary: Role in the group, such as OWNER, MANAGER, or MEMBER.

type.description: Kind of member, such as USER or GROUP.
type.x-epack-summary: Member type, such as USER or GROUP.

status.x-epack-summary: Membership status, for example ACTIVE or SUSPENDED.

delivery_settings.description: How the member gets mail sent to the group.
delivery_settings.x-epack-summary: How the member gets mail sent to the group.

inventory.description: Per-group rows, sorted by member count when the list is capped.
inventory.x-epack-summary: Per-group rows with member count, settings, and member lists.

truncated_inventory.description: Whether the group list was capped at 10,000 rows.
truncated_inventory.x-epack-summary: Whether the group list was capped at 10,000 rows. The largest groups are kept first.

truncated_inventory_dropped.description: Groups left out of the list by the cap.
truncated_inventory_dropped.x-epack-summary: Groups left out of the list by the cap.

truncated_group_memberships.description: Whether the member lists were capped at 200,000 rows across all groups.
truncated_group_memberships.x-epack-summary: Whether the member lists were capped at 200,000 rows across all groups.

org_units.description: Org-unit surface (audit and above; omitted at trust). Audit: total, max_depth, and the per-OU inventory with user_count and the block_inheritance policy-override flag.
org_units.x-epack-summary: The org unit tree. Policies, including 2-step verification enforcement, apply by org unit.

max_depth.description: Deepest nesting of an org unit below the root, which is depth 0.
max_depth.x-epack-summary: Deepest nesting of an org unit below the root. An org unit directly under the root is at depth 1.

parent_path.x-epack-summary: Path of the parent org unit.

user_count.description: Users in the org unit, from the live Directory scan. Null when the scan failed.
user_count.x-epack-summary: Users in any state placed directly in the org unit, from the live Directory scan.

block_inheritance.description: Whether the org unit blocks settings inherited from its parent.
block_inheritance.x-epack-summary: Whether the org unit blocks settings inherited from its parent.

inventory.x-epack-summary: Per-org-unit rows with path, user count, and the inheritance setting.

endpoint.description: Managed-device surface (mobile + Chrome OS; audit and above, omitted at trust). Audit: counts by OS, not_synced_30d, and per-OS compliant / non-compliant breakdowns. Internal: per-device rows (no serial numbers or IMEIs).
endpoint.x-epack-summary: Managed mobile and Chrome OS devices. Serial numbers and IMEIs are never collected.

total.description: Mobile and Chrome OS devices the tenant manages.
total.x-epack-summary: Managed mobile and Chrome OS devices.

additionalProperties.x-epack-summary: Managed devices running this operating system.

not_synced_30d.description: Managed devices that have not synced in the 30 days before the run, or have never synced.
not_synced_30d.x-epack-summary: Managed devices that have not synced in the 30 days before the run, or have never synced.

compliant_by_os.description: Managed devices that count as compliant, by operating system. A mobile device counts when no compromise is detected, and a Chrome OS device when its status is active. A mobile device Google reports no compromise status for is in neither this nor non_compliant_by_os.
compliant_by_os.x-epack-summary: Managed devices that count as compliant, by operating system.

additionalProperties.x-epack-summary: Managed devices on this operating system that count as compliant.

non_compliant_by_os.description: Managed devices that do not count as compliant, by operating system. A mobile device Google reports no compromise status for is in neither this nor compliant_by_os.
non_compliant_by_os.x-epack-summary: Managed devices that do not count as compliant, by operating system.

additionalProperties.x-epack-summary: Managed devices on this operating system that do not count as compliant.

inventory.description: Per-device rows, sorted by last sync when the list is capped. Serial numbers and IMEIs are never collected.
inventory.x-epack-summary: Per-device rows with platform, operating system, owner, and device state. Serial numbers and IMEIs are never collected.

platform.description: Device platform, mobile or Chrome OS.

owner_email.description: The device owner's email address. For a Chrome OS device it is the annotatedUser an admin set, kept only when it is an email address.
owner_email.x-epack-summary: Email of the device owner. A Chrome OS device has one only when an admin noted an email address as its user.

compliant.description: Whether the device counts as compliant. A mobile device counts when no compromise is detected, and a Chrome OS device when its status is active. Null when Google reports no compromise status for a mobile device.
